business_summary.text: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Limited is a specialty retailer of women's ethnic wear, primarily sarees, operating under multiple formats including Kalamandir, Varamahalakshmi, and Valli across South Indian states.

call_points.text: Company is debt-free with sufficient internal resources for expansion, no borrowings needed for next 2-3 years
Wedding calendar has 5-10% more dates than last year, with dates evenly spread across quarters
Varamahalakshmi format contributed 52% of FY26 sales, with Kalamandir format seeing low-single-digit decline

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Tax Demand notices received by Mr. Nagakanaka Durga Prasad Chalavadi (Managing Director) for the for the FY 2019-20, FY 2020-21, FY 2021-22 and FY 2022-23 for an Aggregating Rs. 58,33,48,877
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Central circle 1(3), Hyderabad
tax_litigation.status: The appeals filed by Mr. Nagakanaka Durga Prasad Chalavadi, Promoter of the Company, against the income tax demand to Rs. 58.33 Crore raised by the Office of the Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, in connection with the search and seizure proceedings conducted on May 02, 2023, have been disposed of by the Commissioner of Income Tax. The Commissioner of Income Tax, vide appellate orders dated March 30, 2026, has allowed all the appeals substantially in favour of the Promoter, thereby seeing aside the aforesaid demand. A minor portion amounting to Rs. 85.79 lakhs have been disallowed on account of documentation-related maters, resulting in an estimated tax liability of approximately Rs. 50 lakhs, which will be duly discharged by the Promoter from his personal sources. No impact on the company financial position or operaraons and no liability arises on the Company in this regard.
